review_comments: Stated file size might be a little skewed. I've observed a few files being 1-5kb larger or smaller from the file explorer. I figured 1% is small enough to be a reasonable lower and upper bound to allow room for flexibility and not have it fail if it's not exactly the same amount of KB as SEC says they are
